title: 729. Remove Comments

examples.input: source = ["/*Test program */", "int main()", "{ ", "  // variable declaration ", "int a, b, c;", "/* This is a test", "   multiline  ", "   comment for ", "   testing */", "a = b + c;", "}"]
examples.explanation: Block and line comments are stripped; the declaration line keeps its two leading spaces.
A block spanning three lines joins the outer fragments into ab.
The whole middle line is a line comment and disappears.

testCases.source: ["/*Test program */", "int main()", "{ ", "  // variable declaration ", "int a, b, c;", "/* This is a test", "   multiline  ", "   comment for ", "   testing */", "a = b + c;", "}"]

hints: Scan line by line keeping an in-block flag; // ends the line only when outside a block.
When /* opens outside a block, skip until its matching */ which may sit many lines later.
Buffer the surviving characters per logical line and emit the buffer only when nonempty and outside a block at line end. Adaptation: input is a string_array and output is a string_list.
